description: Update user pages, auth pages, article pages, and remaining feature pages (groups, search, tasks, links, about, messages, favorites, scores, dashboard, install) to use the design system tokens for a complete visual refresh.
steps: Update web/components/user/user-info.tsx, user-profile-card.tsx, user-center-shell.tsx, user-badges.tsx: Apply design system colors. Level badges use var(--color-primary-muted) bg with var(--color-primary) text. Progress bars use forum-progress-bar classes. Avatar borders use var(--color-surface-2). Online indicator uses var(--color-online-indicator).

Update web/components/user/user-follow-list.tsx, user-lists.tsx: Style follow items with proper spacing, var(--color-ink) for names, var(--color-ink-muted) for descriptions, var(--color-hairline) borders.

Update web/components/auth/signin-form.tsx and signup-form.tsx: Apply design system to form layout. Use bg-[var(--color-surface-1)] for card backgrounds. Inputs use the token focus ring. Buttons use var(--color-primary) with proper hover/active states. Third-party login section uses var(--color-hairline) divider.
Update web/components/auth/password-reset-forms.tsx: Same pattern as signin/signup forms.

Update web/app/routes/user.signin.tsx, user.signup.tsx, user.password.forgot.tsx, user.password.reset.tsx, user.email.verify.tsx: Ensure auth pages use var(--color-canvas) background, centered card layout with var(--color-surface-1) bg.

Update web/components/article/article-list.tsx: Article cards use var(--color-surface-1) bg, var(--shadow-sm) shadow, var(--rounded-lg) corners. Hover lifts with var(--shadow-md). Title uses var(--color-ink), meta uses var(--color-ink-muted).

Update web/app/routes/article.$id.tsx, articles.tsx, article.create.tsx, article.edit.$id.tsx: Ensure article reading uses max-width 720px with prose typography (already from bbs-content). Article list page uses proper background.

Update web/app/routes/groups._index.tsx, groups.$slug.tsx, groups.$slug.settings.tsx, groups.create.tsx: Group cards use forum-group-card pattern: var(--color-surface-1) bg, var(--color-hairline) border, var(--shadow-sm) shadow, hover with var(--shadow-md) and translateY(-2px). Replace hardcoded bg-gradient-to-br classes with design token gradients.
Update web/app/routes/search.tsx and web/components/search/: Search input uses design system input tokens. Results use proper card/list styling.

Update web/components/tasks/task-widgets.tsx and tasks-page.tsx: Replace hardcoded slate-* and indigo-* colors with design token variables. Check-in button uses var(--color-primary) bg with checkin-pop animation. Progress bars use forum-progress-bar. User card uses var(--color-surface-1) bg with proper border.
Update web/app/routes/tasks.tsx, links.tsx, about.tsx: Ensure pages use var(--color-canvas) bg, content cards use var(--color-surface-1).
Update web/app/routes/user.messages.tsx, user.favorites.tsx, user.scores.tsx: List items use var(--color-hairline) separators, proper text colors from design system.
Update web/app/routes/user.profile.tsx, user.profile_.account.tsx: Settings forms use design token input styling.

Update dashboard routes and components (web/app/routes/dashboard.*, web/components/dashboard/): Apply --dashboard-surface and --dashboard-panel variables. Sidebar uses var(--color-surface-1). Panel backgrounds use var(--dashboard-panel).
Update web/app/routes/install.tsx: Install wizard form uses design system input and button tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Auth pages use design system surface/ink colors without hardcoded slate/indigo classes
User profile pages use design system level badges and progress bars
Group cards use design system shadow/border/hover patterns
Task widgets use design tokens instead of hardcoded slate/indigo colors
Dashboard panels use the dashboard token variables
All pages use var(--color-canvas) as page background
verification: Run 'pnpm build' in /projects/sandbox/jubensha-go/web/ and confirm no errors
